Yes—I've smoked cigarettes. I am a former smoker. I smoke cigarettes, and I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.

I don’t know.
Have you experienced any shortness of breath or chest pain with deep breaths or coughing?
I don’t know. I do have pain related to why I’m consulting—pain in the posterior chest wall on both the right and left sides.
Is the chest wall pain constant, or does it worsen specifically when you take a deep breath, cough, or move your torso?
I don’t know. The pain is sensitive and feels like a knife stroke, and it’s exhausting. Its intensity is about 2 out of 10, and it’s in the posterior chest wall on both the right and left sides.
How old are you, and approximately how many pack-years of smoking history do you have (packs per day multiplied by years smoked)?
I don’t know. I’m 45 years old and I’ve smoked cigarettes; I’m also exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.

I don’t know.

Yes. I constantly feel fatigued or I have non-restful sleep.

I don't know.

I don’t know. I do know I’ve been coughing, and I’ve been coughing up blood.

I don’t know.

I don’t know. The pain is sensitive and feels like a knife stroke, and it’s exhausting—about 2/10 intensity—in the posterior chest wall on both the right and left sides.

I don’t know. I’ve had an involuntary weight loss over the last 3 months, but I don’t know how much, and I don’t know about any bone pain in other areas.
